sloka: प्रसादम् कुरु मे क्षिप्रम् वश्यो दासो अहम् अस्मि ते ।इमाः शून्या मया वाचः शुष्यमाणेन भाषिताः ॥३-५५-३६॥
transliteration: prasādam kuru me kṣipram vaśyo dāso aham asmi te ।imāḥ śūnyā mayā vācaḥ śuṣyamāṇena bhāṣitāḥ ॥3-55-36॥

translations.english: My throat has dried up. I have spoken these words in a forlorn state. Ravana has never bowed down to a woman in obeisance.
